note: Thin year: Spotify had just launched in ID (Mar 2016) and only a foreign top-5 was reported; home songs come from YouTube Rewind Indonesia 2016 and Google Year in Search 2016. Only one dangdut song has a year-specific source (Kekasihku). Koplo hits of the era (Sambalado, Goyang Dumang, Bang Jono) predate 2016 or lack a 2016-specific source and were left out.

Strong year for dangdut koplo on YouTube (Via Vallen, Nella Kharisma). Spotify Wrapped 2017 Indonesia named only foreign top tracks; home songs rest on YouTube Rewind Indonesia 2017 (detik), Google Year in Search 2017 and Fimela's dangdut list. Surat Cinta Untuk Starla is a 2016 release that peaked in 2017 (Google 2017 #1 search overall).

No Spotify song list for Indonesia 2018 was found (Wrapped coverage named artists/albums only: BTS, Sheila On 7). Year rests on YouTube Indonesia 2018 music list (Jakarta Post), Google Year in Search 2018 and Suara Surabaya's viral-songs roundup. Karna Su Sayang and Deen Assalam may be late-2017 uploads that peaked in 2018. Korban Janji is GuyonWaton's song; Google's entry does not name the artist. Bukti (Oct 2017) and Havana repeat from 2017 because Google ranked them again in 2018.

Spotify Wrapped 2019 Indonesia top 5 confirmed (Jakarta Post); YouTube Rewind Indonesia 2019 and Google Year in Search 2019 add depth. Javanese pop is thin: only Kartonyono Medot Janji has a 2019-specific ranked source. The Didi Kempot 'Sobat Ambyar' revival is well documented but no source names a specific Didi Kempot song as a top song of 2019, so none were included. Cinta Luar Biasa is a 2018 release whose peak year was 2019 (Google's #1 search of 2019 overall).
